events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, marks his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy King
angles.copy: A true titan of British comedy, John Cleese is 87 today! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', which of his iconic roles still makes you laugh out loud?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', was originally released on November 22, 1968, and we're marking its 58th anniversary today.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. An absolute masterpiece of diverse sounds and experimental tracks. What's your go-to song from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was originally released on this day in 1965, marking its 61st anniversary and a pivotal artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A landmark album that pushed boundaries and set new standards. What track from it still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away 46 years ago and would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the song of his that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era or alter ego?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. Still the King! What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page's Riffs
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer with the distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod the Mod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! From The Faces to his incredible solo career, he's given us so many classics. Which one is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Ska King
angles.copy: It's a happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! What's your favourite tune to skank to from the Nutty Boys?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's Soul
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! His voice defined an era. What's the Paul Young track that always gets you singing along?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, business, and philanthropy. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary's Tunes
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! The musical mastermind behind so many Take That hits and a fantastic solo artist. What's your favourite Gary-penned song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British soul and R&B singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy's Hits
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! 'Caribbean Queen', 'When the Going Gets Tough'... so many brilliant tunes. Which one is your favourite?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction anniversary
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 20, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry, and we mark its 41st anniversary today.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: Forty-one years since the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who do you think was the most deserving of those initial inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, which of his songs is your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London, marking 58 years since the iconic event.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. An unforgettable moment in music history! If you were there, what would you have done?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Award-winning singer, songwriter, and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil's Power
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, what's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and entrepreneur Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo domination, what's your favourite JT banger?
